description: Difficulty-ladder probe battery for the Harness VLA beta on native LIBERO (levels 2-3: libero_goal and libero_10). Comparisons are valid only within this protocol, paired by (task_suite, task_id, initial_state_index, seed). This file is instrumentation for reproducible evaluation; it is not a mechanism from arXiv:2607.08448v2.
change_policy: Never edit this file in place. To change the battery, create eval_protocol_v3.json and report results separately.

budgets.note: max_turns and horizon raised vs v1 because libero_10 tasks are long-horizon; beta-only calibration choice so budget exhaustion does not mask other failure modes.

tasks.note: open the middle drawer of the cabinet — articulated fixture, no held object; probes the tau=task_success holding contract
put the bowl on the stove — pick-and-place control within the goal scene
put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket — two-object sequence; probes multi-step planning
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer and close it — pick-and-place plus articulation combo

hidden_tasks.note: Reserved for final held-out evaluation only. Never use during development, tuning or ablations.

conditions.baseline_vla: run_libero_vla_smoke episode (frozen VLA only, no planner)

pairing_rule: A condition comparison is valid only over the identical set of (task_suite, task_id, initial_state_index, seed) tuples completed by both conditions.
